title: Gekiretsu Pachinkers
overview:
The complete pachinko and pachislot strategy software is finally here!

- Pachinko in 3D polygons and texture mapping!
- Thoroughly research and master all 8 popular machines, inside and out!
- Pachislot fully recreated more virtually than ever with ultra-real CG!
- Find the key to winning streaks!
- Win bet after bet in the captivating story mode!
- Packed with events too, like dates and lottery tickets!

パチンコ・パチスロ完全攻略ソフトがついに登場！

パチンコを3Dポリゴン＆テクスチャーマッピング！
■人気全8機種を中までバッチリ研究攻略！
パチスロは超リアルCGでよりバーチャルに完全再現！
■連チャンの糸口をつかもう！
魅惑のストーリーモードで勝負に勝ちまくれ！
■デートや宝くじなど、イベントも充実！
